fixed_conditions.raw_hitlists: Capture once per public case and reuse unchanged for every variant. Three collections top40 each.
fixed_conditions.query_inputs: Only original latest and synthetic/public conversation; no annotations, owners, ranks or labels as query evidence.

snippet_policy.accounting: JSON UTF-8 bytes of reference_matched_snippets value, including names and escaping
snippet_policy.matching: installed path identity; SDK bestChunk only; body/references before meta; score descending then collection/path; candidate-order allocation

development_selection.primary: family-macro best-acceptable-set F1 over resolved development labels, as frozen in harness_evaluation_contract.json
development_selection.eligible: Complete reliable outputs on the same120developmentcases; zero newly introduced no-skill false positives versus original baseline; original Jev service p95 and billed-input-token p95 both at most1.25 times original baseline. Missing original measurements or failures are ineligible.
development_selection.choose: Include the original baseline at each stage. Choose the eligible configuration with the highest primary score. Exact ties prefer smaller pool, then no snippets, then current-max. A stage with no eligible change retains its incoming baseline.
development_selection.uncertainty: Report paired family-bootstrap intervals for every comparison. Do not use holdout outcomes to choose development winners.
development_selection.diagnostic_contender: If the staged winner is unchanged original baseline, freeze the highest-scoring fully completed nonbaseline configuration actually tested as the single diagnostic holdout contender, preferring eligible contenders and the same tie order. Label it diagnostic, not a recommended change. If no nonbaseline completed, retain all failures and report insufficient evidence; do not invent a challenger.

holdout.freeze_before_capture: One baseline/challenger config plus final labels, cases, contract, protocol and implementation hashes; no tuning after holdout results.
holdout.adoption: Use unchanged harness_evaluation_contract.json/harness_metrics.adoption_decision gates: F1 gain>=0.03, bootstrap95% lower>0, no new no-skill FP, reliability, latency/cost ratios<=1.25, hardtimeout and budget. Diagnostic contender status alone does not establish benefit.

task_validation.instruction: Fresh native worker per arm receives only public_task_input and full harness-selected SKILL.md contents plus the corresponding public reference allowlist. It may read necessary listed references and write one artifact. No grader/oracles, expected skills, variant names, peer outputs, tests or revision feedback.
task_validation.remote_host: ssh wei-workspace allowed when heavy compilation is actually needed; current12boundedtasks do not require it.
task_validation.model: Inherit the native runtime model with no override; report exact identity/usage only if observable.

request_bounds.notes: Query intent uses Jev in addition to final selectors. Reuse exact completed payloads/caches; these bounds are request counts, not account billing guarantees.
